subject: english
question: **Select the wrongly spelt word.**
solution:
The wrongly spelt word is: **Disgsting**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct spelling of the word is '**disgusting**'.
 
• The incorrect spelling '**disgsting**' is missing the letter '**u**'.
 
• The word means causing a strong feeling of dislike or nausea. (नापसंदगी या मतली की तीव्र भावना पैदा करना)
 
 
• **Example**: *The sight of the rotting food was disgusting.*
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Contradictory **is spelt correctly and means expressing the opposite. (असंगत)
 
• **Enclosed **is spelt correctly and means closed in or surrounded. (संलग्न करना)
 
• **Sizeable **is spelt correctly and means large in size or amount. (बड़ा)
